description: A2T is published by angepagel. A2T couples ambulance and traffic-light communications in a vehicular-network simulation. Its stated coverage is A configurable ambulance and traffic-network experiment. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. Source code and setup information are linked through the public repository; nothing was installed or executed. The inspected public resource is free to access. Licence: GPL-2.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The README names older Veins, OMNeT++ and SUMO versions; current compatibility was not tested. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
